data: TerraSAR-X descending point set over Kop van Zuid, provided for the course by R.F. Hanssen; aggregates only
frame: local metres: e = x_RD - 93000 (east), n = y_RD - 435600 (north); a cell's south-west corner is (origin_local[0] + cell_m * i, origin_local[1] + cell_m * j), with cell_m given per grid

series.layout: per grid, cell-major [n_cells][288], grids in the order all, ground

spread.what: the standard deviation of the points inside the cell on that pass, after each point's own offset, trend and curvature are removed: what the cell mean leaves out on a single pass. The differing long-term rates are published separately as rate_sd
